BEASTMASTERY_BASE_RIDER_PACKAGE.why: The Rider Package's steed is a Large mount (combat/summons.py 'rider' source: 2x2 token) the rider starts the fight on, sharing its space (combat/ext/mounts.py); Mount and Dismount cost half the rider's Speed; while ridden, the mount takes no damage from a Dexterity save it passes and half when it fails (Skillful Riding).

TAL_BEASTMASTERY_MOUNTED_MANEUVERS.why: The mount may take Dash, Disengage and Dodge (once per turn, the rider's menu) and Shove (the mount's Strength modifier for the DC), combat/ext/mounts.py.

TAL_BEASTMASTERY_SKIRMISH_RIDER.why: The mount's Disengage as a Bonus Action (combat/ext/mounts.py).

TAL_BEASTMASTERY_RUN_DOWN.why: The mount's Overrun as an Action or Bonus Action: Athletics contest, Advantage if larger, Disadvantage if smaller, through the target's space (double cost) and out the far side (combat/ext/mounts.py).

TAL_BEASTMASTERY_TRAMPLING_LINE.why: After the mount succeeds on an Overrun, once per turn one of push 10 ft, Prone, PB Bludgeoning damage or 10 more feet of movement, CL 7+ (combat/ext/mounts.py).

TAL_BEASTMASTERY_SHARED_SADDLE_RHYTHM.why: After the mount's Dash, Disengage or Dodge, once per round one of regain Martial Focus, move 5 ft without Opportunity Attacks, or Temporary HP for the mount, CL 7+ (combat/ext/mounts.py).

tianxia.talent.beastmastery.mounted_offe.why: Advantage on melee attacks by the mounted rider against unmounted creatures smaller than the mount (attack_mode hook, combat/ext/mounts.py).

tianxia.talent.beastmastery.acrobatic_mo.why: The mount's Overrun contest uses the rider's Wisdom (Animal Handling) in place of the mount's Athletics (combat/ext/mounts.py); the mount's Acrobatics has no other combat use.

tianxia.talent.beastmastery.mount_traini.why: Tame Creatures that can be ridden (the mountable Large beasts) are Controlled Mounts, and the sheet can mount them (combat/summons.py, combat/ext/mounts.py).

TAL_BEASTMASTERY_BEASTBACK_RELAY.why: From the start of a turn ridden, transfer onto another of the rider's mounts within 15 feet with no Action and no Opportunity Attack (combat/ext/mounts.py); the one mounted attack is the rider's ordinary attack, which may come before or after.

TAL_BEASTMASTERY_GREAT_BEAST_CHARGE.why: The Action grants the mount's Speed of movement over nonmagical difficult terrain with no Opportunity Attack from the charged creature, then the closing melee attack (3d8 and the Strength save) and the mount's Overrun through one hostile's space open as buttons (combat/ext/mounts.py).
